facts.text: Under the university core curriculum, undergraduate students must complete at least 3 credit hours of experiential learning such as research, internships, study abroad, or service learning.

sources.title: Degree: BA or BS Major: History Catalog Year: 2024-2025 1
sources.quote: At least 3 credit hours in Experiential Learning (defined as Undergraduate Research, Research Intensive with “RI” designation, Internship, Study Abroad, or Service Learning; may be satisfied by courses already required for major).
